title: When the Playlist Falls
author: Elodie Ravensworth
blurb: Beatrix Galloway, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
